tob-10465: John Calvin’s Institutes is the founding text of Reformed Protestantism and one of the most influential books of the Reformation. This first volume lays out his system of doctrine: the nature of God, the authority of Scripture, and the sovereignty of divine grace. Written with lawyer-like precision, it trained generations of pastors and theologians in the Calvinist tradition.
tob-10565: Gertrude Bell’s Hafiz gives the Persian master’s wine-songs and love-lyrics in English verse — poems where the wine-house stands for the soul’s ache and the fair one for God. Wrought ere her desert fame, her versions stay among the most tuneful Hafiz in English.
tob-4165: George Cox’s second Aryan-myth volume bears on with his bold sun-theory of tale — reading gods as sun, dawn, and storm made into persons. His matching way was daring for 1870. The work shows Victorian bookmen grappling with legend’s springs. A bright window on young tale-matching lore.
tob-4265: John Ferguson’s Chemic Book-hoard — book two — lists James Young’s great gathering of gold-books. The book-list is the ground of gold-lore’s book-story. Ferguson’s notes are a treasure of learning. The work stays the needful guide to early chemic letters.
arxiv-2605-08765: Telling a language model to forget something — a copyrighted passage, private data — only matters if the forgetting is real. Renjie Gu, Jiazhen Du, Yihua Zhang, and Sijia Liu argue that today's unlearning methods can lie, looking compliant while secretly retaining the banned knowledge. Their paper designs tests for that honesty and proposes unlearning techniques meant to survive scrutiny.
arxiv-2605-08865: Dirichlet L-functions sit at the heart of analytic number theory, encoding deep secrets about prime numbers. Qiyu Yang and Shengbo Zhao prove Omega results — lower bounds showing these functions must sometimes grow large — for the family. The 2026 paper is pure mathematics, charting how wild these fundamental objects can get.
arxiv-2605-09065: Scene graphs describe an image as objects plus their relationships — cup on table, dog near door. arxiv-2605-09165: Looped language models reuse the same layers repeatedly instead of stacking new ones — but scaling them is tricky. Ryan Lee, Jacob Biloki, Edward J. arxiv-2605-09365: Not every enterprise job needs a giant language model — and forcing one in wastes money and reliability. arxiv-2605-09765: Clinical labels in electronic health records are noisy; multi-view consistency can clean the learned representations anyway. arxiv-2606-16965: Giuseppe Bisicchia and colleagues ask a practical question every quantum programmer faces: how many times must you rerun a quantum circuit to trust the answer? arxiv-2606-17065: Raeid Saqur and colleagues bridge two worlds of options trading: Black-Scholes implied volatility, what the market expects, and actual price objectives. plos-pone-0357765: After rotator cuff repair, the shoulder blade’s stamina matters as much as the cuff itself. plos-pone-0353165: The sable — Siberia’s prized fur-bearer — has a deeper past than assumed. This paper reported the first Boreal Sable in Pleistocene Arctic Siberia. The ancient specimen rewrites where this iconic mustelid roamed during the Ice Age, extending its known range into the far north.
plos-pone-0358265: China’s level-II peacekeeping hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo treats more than battlefield trauma. plos-pone-0358065: Simulating how worms crawl in three dimensions has uses from biology to soft robotics. This paper presented a mathematical model for worm path simulation in 3D. plos-pone-0357565: Hypermobile EDS brings a bewildering mix of symptoms that defy simple categories. plos-pone-0355465: Appearance-focused social media warps how we see ourselves — and the mood pays the price. plos-pone-0357365: PARP inhibitor drugs usually require BRCA mutations to work — but a new player may widen their reach. plos-pone-0351865: Representation is contagious: seeing women in power begets more women in power. plos-pone-0356365: Chronic pain and substance use disorders travel together far too often. plos-pone-0345965: Electroplating wastewater is a toxic cocktail demanding optimized treatment. plos-pone-0354965: Millimeter-wave wireless needs beamforming that scales — and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces can help. plos-pone-0356265: Depression and anxiety among Mozambican women follow stratified, geographic patterns — invisible without mapping. plos-pone-0353565: Face recognition threatens privacy — but the technology itself might protect it. plos-pone-0356065: Root canal sealers must fill every microscopic void — and ultrasound might help them flow. plos-pone-0346465: Reef fish don’t just flee predators — they calibrate their escape to the attack. This paper showed reef fish escape responses selectively match predator attack speeds. The tuned escapes reveal split-second decision-making honed by evolution — waste no energy, miss no threat.
plos-pone-0342165: Understanding an organism’s sensors demands statistical rigor. plos-pone-0355165: Hands-off driving in a second language — cognitively loaded and risky. plos-pone-0353465: England’s urban paradox — cities both healthier and sicker than expected — persists after the pandemic. plos-pone-0354465: Giant Neotropical fireflies — and their kin — flash in patterns science is still cataloging. This paper revised the systematics of these Lampyridae. plos-pone-0354665: Aleuritopteris bicolor — a Nepalese fern — was mined for medicine by bioassay-guided isolation. plos-pone-0353665: Test equating — keeping scores comparable — breaks when data go missing and items drift. plos-pone-0354365: Missense variants in intrinsically disordered protein regions — classifying their pathogenicity — is notoriously hard. This paper enhanced that classification. The improved methods bring diagnostic clarity to the floppy protein regions where disease-causing mutations hide.
plos-pone-0352865: Antisocial personality disorder — treated with mentalisation-based therapy — its cost-effectiveness in English probation. plos-pone-0353765: Synergistic bioactive ointment — zinc oxide nanoparticles with papaya latex and aloe vera — for broad biomedical use. This paper developed and tested it. plos-pone-0353865: Bangladeshi students’ smartphone addiction and academic underachievement — validated scales, with mindful attention’s mediating role. This paper did the Bangla validation. plos-pone-0353365: Vicia faba root nodules from oasis soils — plant growth-promoting bacteria characterized. This paper assessed their soil fertility and crop potential. plos-pone-0351965: Astronauts aboard the International Space Station — value dynamics and interpersonal tension during missions. This paper examined them. plos-pone-0353265: Debonded orthodontic brackets — bond strength after reconditioning and priming protocols, in vitro. This paper tested them. The findings guided the rebonding. plos-pone-0352665: Internal temporary migration in northern Bangladesh — destination choices. This paper studied them with evidence. The analysis revealed where the seasonal migrants go. plos-pone-0352165: Botswana university students — HIV testing barriers’ determinants and predictive modeling. This paper studied them. The analysis mapped why the young don’t test. plos-pone-0343565: Colorectal cancer-associated bacterial key genes — identified in silico for anti-cancer exploration. This paper did so. The analysis mined the microbiome-cancer link. plos-pone-0349765: Societal self-centricity — evidence from five decades of popular music across three continents. This paper asked whether we’ve grown more self-focused. plos-pone-0351765: Genitourinary syndrome of menopause — photobiomodulation therapy evaluated in a single-center prospective study. This paper did so. europmc-pmc2815665: XDS is one of the most widely used programs for processing X-ray diffraction data from crystals, and this 2010 paper is its defining reference. europmc-pmc2855365: The vaginal germ crowd shifts with time, and this 2010 study clocks it. The team tracks germ shifts in women and their tie to bacterial vaginosis. Their logs show which shifts spell trouble. The work aids tests that read the whole community, not just one bug.

europmc-pmc2917065: The immune drug ipilimumab offered hope in advanced melanoma. This 2010 paper reports a single hospital's compassionate-use experience, finding lymphocyte count after two doses tracks with survival. The authors' bedside clue aided early calls. Their report guided real-world use.
